title: Solid Core vs. Cellular Core PVC Pipe in DWV Systems
description: Understanding the structural differences in DWV piping materials is essential for compliant installations. Solid core Schedule 40 PVC consists of uniform plastic throughout the pipe wall, offering higher structural rigidity and impact resistance. Cellular core pipe features a lightweight density layer sandwiched between solid outer walls. While cellular core PVC meets standard residential DWV requirements and is easier to cut, solid core is often preferred or required for underground installations, commercial applications, or areas subject to higher physical stress.
